answer: Port scanning works by utilizing a combination of techniques to determine the state of the ports on a remote device. Any service or application that uses TCP or UDP networking will have ports open for communication over the network. This process helps identify which ports are open, closed, or filtered, thereby revealing information about the services running on the target system [Source 1].
